response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with strong systems and full-stack background, but the resume shows minimal recent hands-on Java experience and no Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or IDE-internals/tooling work. Core stack for the last several years has been TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and GraphQL, which does not align with the JVM/enterprise Java tooling focus of this role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience across many languages and platforms
Strong track record of ownership on complex, large-scale systems and infrastructure
History of teaching, mentoring, and driving developer-experience initiatives
concerns: No mention of Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate frameworks
No IDE internals, language tooling, or compiler/plugin development experience

key_factors.factor: Lack of Spring/Kotlin/enterprise JVM framework experience
No IDE internals or language tooling background
Deep general software engineering expertise and complex systems experience
